name: end-card
description: An end card built on screen: up to three lines carried in word by word, then a rule wiped in under them.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: a line, or a list of up to three; the first is large, the rest muted

parameters.name: rule
parameters.description: True to draw the accent rule under the lines

returns: VGroup with .lines (the texts) and .rule, and .build() the steps for self.steps: lines in together, then the rule
